title: Trivy - Security overview
description: Daily security report from trivy-operator on every cluster: new CVEs, critical findings to fix, compliance.

panels.title: Morning scorecard (one row per cluster, click a number to drill down)
Cluster scorecard
panels.description: Unique CVE IDs per cluster (Critical/High), failed checks (config audit + RBAC + infra), secrets found in images, failed compliance controls (sum over all specs), images on end-of-life OS. Scrape = whether Prometheus can reach the trivy-operator of the cluster: if DOWN the numbers are stale or missing. New CVEs: Critical/High CVE IDs not seen in the cluster during the 7d before the window (empty while Prometheus has less history).

targets.expr: count by (cluster) (count by (cluster, vuln_id) (trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity="Critical"})) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)
count by (cluster) (count by (cluster, vuln_id) (trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity="High"})) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)

count by (cluster) (count by (cluster, vuln_id) ((trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity=~"Critical|High"} unless on (cluster, vuln_id) last_over_time(trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster"}[7d] offset $new_window) and on (cluster) (max_over_time(up{job=~"trivy-operator.*"}[7d] offset $new_window) == 1)))) or on (cluster) (group by (cluster) (max_over_time(up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}[7d] offset $new_window)) * 0)

count by (cluster) (count by (cluster, namespace, resource_kind, resource_name) (trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity="Critical"})) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)

count by (cluster) ((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_configaudits_info{config_audit_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity="Critical"}, "check_id", "$1", "config_audit_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "config_audit_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "config_audit_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "config_audit_category", "(.*)"), "report", "config", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_rbacassessments_info{rbac_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity="Critical"}, "check_id", "$1", "rbac_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "rbac_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "rbac_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "rbac_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "rbac", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_infraassessments_info{infra_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity="Critical"}, "check_id", "$1", "infra_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "infra_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "infra_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "infra_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "infra", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)"))) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)

count by (cluster) ((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_configaudits_info{config_audit_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity="High"}, "check_id", "$1", "config_audit_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "config_audit_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "config_audit_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "config_audit_category", "(.*)"), "report", "config", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_rbacassessments_info{rbac_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity="High"}, "check_id", "$1", "rbac_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "rbac_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "rbac_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "rbac_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "rbac", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_infraassessments_info{infra_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity="High"}, "check_id", "$1", "infra_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "infra_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "infra_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "infra_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "infra", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)"))) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)
sum by (cluster) (trivy_image_exposedsecrets{cluster=~"$cluster"}) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)
sum by (cluster) (trivy_cluster_compliance{cluster=~"$cluster", status="Fail"}) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)

count by (cluster) (count by (cluster, image_repository, image_tag) (trivy_image_info{cluster=~"$cluster", image_os_eosl="true"})) or (group by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 0)
max by (cluster) (up{job=~"trivy-operator.*", cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: New CVEs (not seen in the cluster before the last $new_window)
panels.description: CVE IDs present now that were never reported for the same cluster in the 7d before the selected window. Click a CVE for details and affected workloads.

targets.expr: count by (cluster, vuln_id, severity, vuln_score, vuln_title, published_date) ((trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity=~"$severity"} unless on (cluster, vuln_id) last_over_time(trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster"}[7d] offset $new_window) and on (cluster) (max_over_time(up{job=~"trivy-operator.*"}[7d] offset $new_window) == 1)))

panels.title: Open CVEs ($severity) by package
panels.description: One row per CVE and package version: upgrade the package to 'Fixed in'.

targets.expr: count by (cluster, vuln_id, severity, vuln_score, vuln_title, resource, installed_version, fixed_version) (trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity=~"$severity"})

panels.title: Failed checks ($severity)
panels.description: Failed config audit (workloads), RBAC (roles) and infra (control plane / nodes) checks. Click a check for remediation and affected resources.

targets.expr: count by (cluster, report, severity, check_id, title) ((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_configaudits_info{config_audit_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity=~"$severity"}, "check_id", "$1", "config_audit_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "config_audit_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "config_audit_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "config_audit_category", "(.*)"), "report", "config", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_rbacassessments_info{rbac_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity=~"$severity"}, "check_id", "$1", "rbac_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "rbac_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "rbac_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "rbac_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "rbac", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_infraassessments_info{infra_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", severity=~"$severity"}, "check_id", "$1", "infra_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "infra_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "infra_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "infra_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "infra", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Compliance (summary reports)
panels.description: Cluster compliance reports (CIS, NSA, Pod Security Standards) refreshed every 6h.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, title) (trivy_cluster_compliance{cluster=~"$cluster", status="Pass"}) / sum by (cluster, title) (trivy_cluster_compliance{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * 100
sum by (cluster, title) (trivy_cluster_compliance{cluster=~"$cluster", status="Fail"})
count by (cluster, title, compliance_id, compliance_name, severity) (trivy_compliance_info{cluster=~"$cluster", status="Fail", severity=~"(?i)${severity:regex}"})

panels.title: Images with exposed secrets
panels.description: Secrets (keys, tokens, passwords) found in container image layers.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, resource_kind, resource_name, container_name, image_repository, image_tag, severity) (trivy_image_exposedsecrets{cluster=~"$cluster"}) > 0

panels.title: Images on end-of-life OS
panels.description: Base OS no longer receives security fixes: rebuild on a supported base image.

targets.expr: count by (cluster, image_repository, image_tag, image_os_family, image_os_name) (trivy_image_info{cluster=~"$cluster", image_os_eosl="true"})
count by (cluster) (count by (cluster, vuln_id) (trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity="Critical"}))
count by (cluster) (count by (cluster, vuln_id) (trivy_vulnerability_id{cluster=~"$cluster", severity="High"}))
